newsitem.title: USA: Texas 600 MW power line to reduce flows for work.
newsitem.headline: Texas 600 MW power line to reduce flows for work.

text.p: A 600 megawatt electricity line connecting the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) and the Southwest Power Pool (SPP) will reduce flows next week for maintenance, an ERCOT spokesman said Wendesday.
The DC line between the two regions in northeastern Texas will not be available for imports to ERCOT from February 24 to 28 for the planned maintenance work, the spokesman said.
Exports from ERCOT into SPP will continue at normal levels during the maintenance, the spokesman said.
Maintenance work planned for March 12 to 18 will reduce imports to ERCOT on the same line to 300 MW, while exports from ERCOT will continue at normal levels, the spokesman said.
